A '''concussion charge''' was a type of explosive. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] used concussion charges in a trap for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
